Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring the delivery of endorsements by recording officers.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to delivery of endorsements by recording officers;and amending RCW 65.04.090.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 65.04.090 and 1996 c 229 s 5 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The recording officer must also endorse upon such an instrument,paper, or notice, the time when and the book and page in which it isrecorded, and must thereafter electronically transmit or deliver it((,upon request,)) to the party leaving the same for record or to theaddress on the face of the document.
